items.text: Schwab lists 'Schwab Starter Kit™' and 'Schwab Teen Investor™ Account' as offerings for younger investors, alongside 'No / low commissions'.
items.quote: Younger investors | Schwab Starter Kit TM | Schwab Teen Investor TM Account | No / low commissions

items.text: Schwab supports newer investors with accessible products such as Schwab Stock Slices® and the Schwab Starter Kit®, along with trading capabilities, advisory solutions, and educational resources.

items.text: Schwab began a phased rollout to retail clients of Schwab Crypto™, its spot crypto trading offer providing direct access to bitcoin and ether trading combined with educational content and professional support.

items.quote: Crypto will be great for clients and will certainly appeal to young investors. But we are absolutely crushing it with young investors today.

items.text: Schwab's CEO said the support, service, education, and leading thinkorswim platform and digital capabilities offered to young investors is unmatched, which is why Schwab is succeeding with young investors.
items.quote: I think what we can offer the young investor in terms of the support, the service, the education, and of course, the leading platform with thinkorswim and our digital capabilities, I think is unmatched.

items.text: Schwab's CEO said younger investors' top online resource is YouTube, and Schwab is the number one financial services firm on YouTube by followers; Schwab meets younger clients in the channels where they turn for information.

items.text: Schwab puts on 35 hours a week of live content teaching investors how to trade and invest, and has about a thousand former trading professionals answering phones for investors seeking advice and expertise.
